findings.classification: New entry-point bounds defect, not v4 capability omission
findings.problem: A generic spectral velocity space or explicit T0 inconsistent with the Hermite/Maxwellian representation previously passed problem creation and failed later or changed physical scaling.
findings.resolution: Validate a centered Maxwellian times ordered normalized Hermite modes, argument scale 1/sqrt(T), positive finite scalar temperature and agreement with explicit config.T0; preserve official Hermite factory paths.

findings.classification: New entry-point bounds defect, not v4 capability omission
findings.problem: A non-angular L2/Hermite element inside SumSpace passes radiation.problem and then solve reads missing DimReduction. A nodal macro basis also lacks the Product.Lhs contract used by retained level construction.
findings.resolution: Validate actual L2SphereElement/angular macro capabilities and the shared physical domain/chart. Compatible symmetry factories retain the same S^2 even when factory dimension/reduction labels differ. Independent positive and negative representation tests pass.

findings.classification: Existing multidimensional boundary defect, not omitted implementation
findings.problem: Boundary index 2*(1:nd)-(field>0) expands row minus column into an nd-by-nd array, selecting wrong planes on unequal axis bounds. Equal square lower bounds hide the error.
findings.resolution: Normalize field to a row for per-axis indexing. Independent corner case uses [0,2]x[-1,3], velocity [2;-4] and t_entry=1-min(x/2,(3-y)/4).

findings.classification: Existing v4 example defect, not omitted source
findings.problem: ex00_func_approx and ex05_generalization treat 2D-topology angular Volume.Nodes as 2-row Cartesian data and evaluate a one-coordinate Fourier/RBF chart with [cos(theta);sin(theta)]. The helper reads a nonexistent second row or doubles the sample count.
findings.resolution: Both actual study entry points now fit/evaluate the one-coordinate chart, accept controlled numeric/plot/output options and return all original scenarios. ex05 wrapped Gaussian normalization is analytic and shared across all grids; original node order/offsets/RBF settings and default research budgets remain.

findings.problem: Initial/source/trace callbacks receive physical Cartesian velocity through VLhsNodes/VRhsNodes. distribution and kineticReconstruct(v=...) evaluate the velocity basis directly, so v is its chart coordinate, e.g. the raw Volume.Nodes for a spherical basis.
findings.resolution: State this boundary explicitly in the application math/API documentation; changing generic MacroMicroState to reject non-sphere elements would incorrectly restrict its retained reconstruction capability.

findings.classification: Existing public custom-factor protocol defect, not omitted source
findings.problem: SeparableOdeIntegrator.factorStep passed the composition object to a factor-specific callback; public factor.step re-entry with effective dt therefore called the wrong method.
findings.resolution: Pass the actual getFactor(i), retaining the complete operator options and effective Lie/Strang substep. Unified factor dispatch now retains F as a candidate-state nonlinear term, including the BDF public-F support developed in parallel.
findings.testCorrection: The independent BE/FE composition callback now forwards only L/F/S/M/dt supported by the non-augmented FE method. Factor identity, effective substeps, independent noncommuting matrix composition and history assertions remain unchanged.
